mapper.select: SELECT id,type_name AS name,base_price AS price,max_guests AS maxGuests FROM room_type WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM booking_order WHERE create_by=#{employeeId} AND booking_request_id=#{key} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT room_type_id FROM booking_order WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT FROM booking_order WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.id,l.inventory_id AS inventoryId,l.lock_room_count AS roomCount,l.lock_status AS status FROM inventory_lock_record l JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.id=l.inventory_id WHERE l.order_id=#{orderId} AND l.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY i.stay_date,l.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE room_type_inventory SET booked_rooms=#{booked},checked_in_rooms=#{checkedIn},available_rooms=#{available} WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0 AND total_rooms=#{booked}+#{checkedIn}+#{available}
UPDATE inventory_lock_record SET lock_status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0 AND lock_status='locked'
mapper.select: SELECT id,room_type_id AS roomTypeId,room_no AS roomNo,physical_status AS physicalStatus FROM room WHERE is_deleted=0 AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.id,d.inventory_id AS inventoryId,d.room_type_id AS roomTypeId,d.room_id AS roomId,d.status,d.is_occupied AS occupied,d.checkin_record_id AS checkinId FROM room_inventory_detail d JOIN room_type_inventory i ON i.id=d.inventory_id WHERE d.is_deleted=0 AND d.inventory_id IN #{id} AND d.room_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.stay_date,d.room_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,room_id AS roomId,checkin_by AS employeeId,checkin_request_id AS requestId,checkin_request_hash AS requestHash FROM checkin_record WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY room_id
mapper.update: UPDATE room_inventory_detail SET is_occupied=1,checkin_record_id=#{checkinId} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND is_occupied=0 AND checkin_record_id IS NULL AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE room SET physical_status='OCCUPIED' WHERE id=#{id} AND physical_status='READY' AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE booking_order SET status='CHECKED_IN' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE booking_order SET status='CANCELLED',cancel_time=#{now},cancel_by=#{employeeId},cancel_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND is_deleted=0
